notes: This is a low-profile, half-length PCIe Gen3 x4 capture/playout card (not a standalone rack unit), so rackUnits is omitted and no discrete power port is listed — it is bus-powered entirely from the PCIe slot with no external/auxiliary power connector per the manufacturer spec page. Model naming convention: "11" = 1 SDI input / 1 SDI output; "key" = integrated hardware keyer for graphics overlay mixing. Video I/O is single-link 4:2:2 10-bit over BNC, supporting SD-SDI up to 12G-SDI (ST 2082-10), so both video ports are graded sdi-12g (max supported). A third BNC carries the blackburst/tri-level sync (genlock) reference input, which also natively carries LTC; this reference port is not bandwidth-graded since it is a sync/timecode signal, not an SDI payload path — its exact bracket silkscreen label could not be confirmed (site describes it functionally as "reference input" rather than showing a labeled photo), so the port name is a best-effort description. Up to 16 audio channels per HD-SDI link (32 per 3G-SDI link) are embedded/de-embedded within the SDI signal itself, not via separate physical audio ports.
